verdict.rationale: The official Codex README tells users to run `codex` and select "Sign in with ChatGPT" so they can use Codex as part of their Plus, Pro, Business, Edu, or Enterprise plan, with an API key as an alternative. Community users describe running Codex on their subscription quota, which corroborates that the path works in practice. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the sign-in flow beyond the README mention, and documented per-plan usage limits and which surfaces (CLI, IDE, app, web) each plan covers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with my existing product subscription plan to use the coding agent

citations.quote: Run `codex` and select **Sign in with ChatGPT**. We recommend signing into your ChatGPT account to use Codex as part of your Plus, Pro, Business, Edu, or Enterprise plan.
You can also use Codex with an API key, but this requires additional setup.
five days before my Codex subscription ends, I have to switch to Anthropic because at least I'll be able to use my quota
